compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AMS1117-3.3 assigns GND (GND) whereas AP7361C-33E-13 assigns IN (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AMS1117-3.3 assigns VOUT (VOUT) whereas AP7361C-33E-13 assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AMS1117-3.3 assigns VIN (VIN) whereas AP7361C-33E-13 assigns OUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: ESR-Sensitive · >=22 µF · See datasheet ESR curve
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT). Soldering AP7361C-33E-13 onto a AMS1117-3.3 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT HAZARD: Exposed thermal pad/tab net conflict (VOUT vs GND) — direct swap will short power rails.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AP7361C-33E-13 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 2.2 µF, p.1), whereas AMS1117-3.3 is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: See datasheet ESR curve). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on AMS1117-3.3 can trigger control-loop oscillation.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 10x (AMS1117-3.3: 22 µF p.4 vs AP7361C-33E-13: 2.2 µF p.1); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7361C-33E-13 is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.4) vs AMS1117-3.3 at 15 V rec. (15 V abs max, p.2). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AMS1117-3.3: 1100 mV p.3 vs AP7361C-33E-13: 340 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP7361C-33E-13 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6.5 V, p.4) than AMS1117-3.3 (15 V, p.2); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6.5 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AMS1117-3.3 requires Vin,min >= 4.8 V (p.2) vs 2.2 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AMS1117-3.3: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ) vs AP7361C-33E-13: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA, TJ up to +150°C)); AP7361C-33E-13 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AMS1117-3.3 (Advanced Monolithic Systems, SOT-223-3) and AP7361C-33E-13 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 22.9 °C on AMS1117-3.3 (θJA 90 °C/W) vs 28.1 °C on AP7361C-33E-13 (θJA 110 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 83.3x ratio (5000 µA (p.3) vs 60 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AMS1117-3.3 "NOT Ceramic-Cap Stable — Requires 22 uF Solid Tantalum (No Numeric ESR Window Published)" (p.4) and AP7361C-33E-13 "CRITICAL E vs. ER Suffix Pinout Trap — AP7361C-33E-13 is INCOMPATIBLE with 1117 Pads" (p.15). BOM decision: Choose AMS1117-3.3 when input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 15 V) or lower package θJA (90 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose AP7361C-33E-13 when battery sleep budget demands 60 µA Iq or your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
